extracted.name: Beef and Beet Borscht
extracted.description: This beef borscht is Chef John's version of the Russian and Polish soup with beets and cabbage simmered in a homemade broth made from bone-in shank.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 inch thick) slice bone-in beef shank
0.25 cup white vinegar, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill, for garnish
instruction_lines: Cook beef shank in a large soup pot over high heat until browned, about 3 minutes per side. Add water, onion, carrots, celery, and bay leaf; bring to a simmer and cook until meat is tender and falling off the bone, about 4 hours. Strain broth and discard solids.
Combine beef broth, beets, and cabbage in the same pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until beets are tender, about 30 minutes. Reduce heat to low; add vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Serve soup in bowls garnished with sour cream and dill.
